Subject: Q1 Travel & Entertainment Spend — Sales Team Summary

Hi Denise,

Before the quarterly review on Thursday, here's the travel and entertainment breakdown for the West region sales team. I pulled these from the expense system after reconciling against the booking portal export.

| Category | Q1 Actual | Q1 Budget | Variance |
|---|---|---|---|
| Airfare | $48,320 | $45,000 | +$3,320 |
| Lodging | $31,975 | $30,000 | +$1,975 |
| Ground transport | $9,140 | $8,500 | +$640 |
| Client meals | $12,680 | $11,000 | +$1,680 |
| **Total** | **$102,115** | **$94,500** | **+$7,615** |

The overage is almost entirely driven by the two customer summit trips in February — Boston and Austin both had last-minute fare changes after the weather cancellations. Nothing looks mis-coded, and Preeti in finance has already signed off on the reclassifications.

A few notes for the deck: the chatbot we trialed in the booking portal did cut average search-to-book time from about 14 minutes to 9, but it didn't affect spend. Also, four reps are still booking outside policy for regional flights under $300, which we should decide whether to tighten.

Let me know if you want the raw export as CSV before Thursday.

Thanks,
Marcus Oyelaran
Sales Operations, Halverson Ridge Systems

Subject: Re: Unit 4B lease renewal — terms confirmed

Hi Tomás, following our call this morning I've confirmed with the landlord's office that the renewal for Unit 4B at 1180 Fairweather Lane will run 1 September 2025 through 31 August 2026 at $2,340 per month, a 3.5% increase over the current rate. The security deposit stays at one month's rent, and the parking space in the rear lot is included as before. The only substantive change is the new 60-day notice clause for early termination, which replaces the old 30-day term. I'll courier two originals to your office by Friday, and you can sign and return one; the landlord's signature page will already be completed. If anything in the draft doesn't match what we discussed, reply by Wednesday so I can catch the landlord's agent before the file closes.

Subject: Confirmation — Dr. Amara Whitfield, 14 May

Dear Mr. Halloran, this is a reminder that your appointment with Dr. Amara Whitfield at Northgate Family Medicine is scheduled for Wednesday, 14 May at 10:20 a.m. at our Lakeview office, 220 Lakeview Terrace, Suite 310. Please arrive fifteen minutes early to complete the updated intake form, which you can also fill in online through the patient portal beforehand. If you need to reschedule, give us at least 24 hours' notice at 555-0188 or reply to this email. Note that Dr. Whitfield will be away from 20 to 30 May, so if you'd like a follow-up before then, we should book it now. Insurance details on file are still with Meridian Health Plan; bring your card in case anything has changed.

Subject: Room block code for the Denver offsite

Hi all — the group code for the March sales offsite at the Marriott on 17th Street is HRSOFF25; use it when you book so rooms land under the company block at $189/night.

Subject: Lease addendum signature needed by Friday

Tomás — the landlord added a pet addendum (one cat, $25/month) to the renewal packet; please sign page 3 and send it back before Friday so the file can close.

Subject: Updated policy on booking travel through the assistant

Hi team, as of Monday we're piloting the new travel assistant inside the booking portal, and I want to set expectations clearly. The tool can search fares, hold a reservation for up to 24 hours, and draft a request for manager approval, but it cannot confirm payment or change an existing ticket — those still go through me or the portal's manual flow. A few of you have asked whether it reads your calendar; it does, but only to suggest departure times, and it never emails anyone on your behalf. If it proposes something that looks wrong, screenshot it and send it to the ops alias rather than acting on it. The pilot runs through the end of Q2, and we'll review adoption and error rates before deciding whether to keep it.

Subject: Re: parking sticker

Tomás, the management office says the new parking sticker will be in your mailbox by Monday — the old one is fine until then.

Subject: Bloodwork before your visit

Mr. Halloran — Dr. Whitfield would like a fasting lipid panel drawn before the 14 May appointment; any Northgate lab can do it, no separate booking needed.

Subject: Q1 report draft attached

Denise — draft of the Q1 travel summary is in the shared drive under Finance/Quarterly; the chatbot usage numbers are on tab 4 if you want them for the deck.

Subject: Lease start date

Tomás — confirming the lease term begins 1 September, so your first rent payment is due that day, not before.
